hints.title: Count Vowels in Each Word
hints.text: For every word in the sentence, count the number of vowels it contains.

hints.title: Identify Target Words
hints.text: Find the maximum vowel count across all words and identify words achieving that maximum.

hints.title: Reverse Characters of Target Words
hints.text: For each identified target word, reverse its characters in-place using two scanning positions or string slicing.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Multiple splits and joins without tracking vowel counts can distort whitespace.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Splitting words requires O(n) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean linear scan, vowel tallying, and selective reversal.
